about.summary: I love Building systems that make sense.
about.specialization: Distributed backend architectures, GraphQL & REST API design, Redis caching, event-driven messaging with Kafka, and enterprise integrations (Salesforce CRM, Dynamics 365, Firebase Auth).

metrics.primaryStack: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, GraphQL, Kafka, Redis

experience.description: Building and scaling distributed backend microservices, real-time event-driven pipelines, and cross-system synchronization workflows.
highlights: Engineered resilient event-driven microservices in Node.js and TypeScript, handling real-time data streaming and asynchronous transaction processing.
Developed bi-directional data synchronization mechanisms across enterprise CRM and ERP systems, ensuring strict referential integrity and zero record duplication.
Optimized API payload transformation pipelines to convert complex enterprise domain schemas with sub-second processing latencies.
Partnered with cross-functional engineering, product, and QA teams to diagnose distributed edge cases and maintain service reliability.

experience.description: Engineered production GraphQL and REST APIs, integrated enterprise services, and built event-driven activity streaming pipelines.
highlights: Developed and maintained high-traffic REST and GraphQL API services supporting real-time account operations for 350K+ active users.
Implemented multi-tier caching architectures with Redis to optimize database read performance and accelerate high-frequency queries to under 10ms.
Integrated secure identity management and granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to protect sensitive account and billing transactions.
Built background Kafka event producers to capture telemetry, track user lifecycle events, and trigger automated downstream actions.
Participated actively in sprint planning, code reviews, and performance profiling to eliminate latency bottlenecks across services.

experience.description: Contributed to backend services, error analysis, and performance optimization for production customer platforms.
highlights: Gained hands-on experience with backend technologies, contributing to real-world customer-facing systems.
Diagnosed error scenarios, refactored bottlenecks, and improved API throughput and database query performance.

projects.title: Sales Order Orchestrator
projects.description: Enterprise event-driven order orchestration and synchronization platform bridging sales operations in Salesforce CRM with operational fulfillment and provisioning in Microsoft Dynamics 365.
highlights: Designed and developed scalable  backend microservices using Node.js and TypeScript to consume real-time domain events via Apache Kafka and automate end-to-end order execution in Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Implemented complex payload transformation and mapping pipelines to convert nested Salesforce domain models and commercial order structures into Dynamics OData REST API schemas.

Engineered an asynchronous bi-directional sync loop to capture operational system identifiers and update upstream CRM records, ensuring cross-system referential integrity and preventing duplicate records.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional engineering, CRM, and QA teams to troubleshoot production edge cases, and ensure seamless releases.

projects.title: Customer Self-Service Portal
projects.description: High-scale customer-facing self-service platform supporting 350K+ residential telecom customers with real-time billing, account management, and operational workflows.
highlights: Designed and developed scalable backend APIs using Node.js and TypeScript supporting billing, payments, and customer operations.
Integrated Firebase Authentication with robust role-based access control (RBAC) to enforce secure authentication and authorization workflows.
Leveraged Redis caching to optimize throughput and achieve sub-10ms response times for high-frequency customer queries.
Published customer activity events to Apache Kafka, enabling downstream business analytics and automated behavior tracking.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot complex production issues and ensure maximum system reliability.
